Free API keys

Sign in to make your keys.

Sign in with your EVE Online character, then make, see and revoke your free keys here. The sign-in asks for no scopes: it only reads which character signed in.

Sign in

One character is one account. Keys you made earlier on ai.eve-cyno.dev with the same character are already here.

EVE Online logs you in on its own page and sends you back. We keep a session cookie for 4 hours, and nothing else about the visit.

What a key gives you

  • 10,000 requests a day for each key.
  • Up to 3 active keys, and 10 new keys a day.
  • Higher per-minute limits than no key.

No key at all works too, at lower limits. Signed in with Discord instead? Use /apikey in the EVE-Cyno Discord to manage the same keys.

How to use a key
